RE: Synthetic, Sam (PHN SYNTH-PHN-9999)
History: Asthma diagnosed age 7. Never smoker. Previously on reslizumab from 2023-01-10 to 2023-12-01, stopped for lack of efficacy.
Medications: Trelegy 200/62.5/25 mcg one inhalation daily; Ventolin 100 mcg PRN.
Investigations: Blood eosinophils 0.62 x10^9/L, collected 2026-08-01.
Impression: Severe eosinophilic asthma, uncontrolled despite high-dose ICS/LABA/LAMA.
Plan: Apply for Drug Z.
Asthma exacerbation. Prednisone 50 mg daily x5d.
Asthma exacerbation after a cold. Prednisone 50 mg daily x5d.
Gout flare. Colchicine started. Asthma ok.
